title: Kodex
author: R. Gaye Önel
description: “What if the best thing that ever happened to you was losing your memory?” After a devastating accident, she moves in with her aunt, determined to start over; go to college, paint, and honor her late parents. But when a mysterious stranger from her past reappears, her carefully built world collapses. Drawn into the orbit of the enigmatic Aram Alevhan, she is forced to question everything: her family, her friends, even her own reflection. Her memories are locked away in darkness, and the truth they conceal may destroy her or transform her forever. Suspenseful, romantic, and haunting, Kodex is a gripping exploration of memory, identity, and the dangerous allure of forbidden love.
